canonical.kubernetes: Runs on the OneMind Kubernetes cluster (DOKS).
canonical.digitalocean: Other DigitalOcean infrastructure that is not Kubernetes (droplet, managed database, Spaces, App Platform).
canonical.saas: A provider-hosted service we use as a customer (Zoho, Gmail, Dropbox, 1Password and similar).
canonical.home: Home, edge or on-premises service reached over the tailnet or a leaf node.
canonical.device: A physical device or vehicle firmware.
canonical.desktop: A desktop application installed on a computer.
canonical.mobile: A mobile application installed on a phone or tablet.
canonical.web: A reference website. Not an app OneMind runs or depends on operationally.
canonical.planned: Recorded for future use; not deployed anywhere yet.
canonical.unknown: Hosting has not been established. Shown visibly, never hidden.

legacy.digitalocean-nyc3: kubernetes (when the entity carries an Argo, workload or Kubernetes selector annotation), otherwise digitalocean
